Name: Alice Nguyen
Performance Rating: 4.5
Recommended Adjustment: +7%

Performance Rating: 2.1

    """Append the confidential performance notes to the file at ``target_path``.

    Args:
        target_path: Path to the file to which the notes should be appended.
    """
    with open(target_path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(CONFIDENTIAL_NOTES)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    append("notes.txt")
